source.manualTitle: Whirlpool & Maytag 9.2 Cu. Ft. Steam Dryer Service Manual

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before accessing.

steps.title: Continue procedure
steps.body: Service Diagnostics entered. Use Key Activation, fault scroll, or Service Test as needed, then continue below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: After diagnostic entry, proceed with OEM component test steps.

steps.title: Access drum LED circuit
steps.body: Remove console. Verify J6 drum LED connector seated at ACU.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove console. Verify J6 drum LED connector seated at ACU.

images.caption: Drum light and moisture sensor access (W11737351 p.12)
Removing top panel and console/HMI (W11737351 p.8)

steps.title: Drum LED harness
steps.body: Check inline connections between drum LED and ACU J6.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Check inline connections between drum LED and ACU J6.

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Repair or replace drum LED harness.

steps.title: J6 driver current (150 mA)
steps.body: Unplug J6. Milliamps across J6 pins 1 & 3, power on, door open — expect ~150 mA if ACU driver OK.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug J6. Milliamps across J6 pins 1 & 3, power on, door open — expect ~150 mA if ACU driver OK.

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Replace ACU — drum LED driver missing.

steps.title: Repair harness
steps.oemOutcome: Repair drum LED harness or connections.

steps.title: Replace ACU
steps.oemOutcome: Replace ACU when 150 mA present but LED still dark.
